page_title: NEW 5-1 AST | Newcastle v Aston Villa 12/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Aston Villa take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+2' Eddie Howe has decided to make a change. Elliot Anderson (Newcastle Utd) replaces Sandro Tonali.
90+2' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) is given a yellow card.

90+1' 5 - 1 Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the right side of the goal.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
87' That's the end of the game for Moussa Diaby, who is replaced by Philippe Coutinho (Aston Villa).
87' It's time for a substitution. Jaden Philogene-Bidace (Aston Villa) comes on in place of Matty Cash.
87' Newcastle have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' Substitution. Jacob Murphy (Newcastle Utd) on for Miguel Almiron.
85' Eddie Howe prepares a substitution. Bruno Guimaraes is replaced by Sean Longstaff (Newcastle Utd).
83' Joelinton (Newcastle Utd) jumps highest to win the header from the corner, but his close-range attempt is well blocked by a defender.
82' Newcastle have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
82' Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save. Newcastle get a corner.
79' Andy Madley sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
78' The Newcastle players halt their celebrations as referee Andy Madley makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
77' 4 - 1 Goal - 4:1! Harvey Barnes laid the ball off to Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd), who slots it into the back of the net from close range, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
75' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
74' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Nick Pope easily deals with the threat.
74' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 7:3.
70' The referee signals a corner kick to Newcastle.
68' Eddie Howe has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harvey Barnes (Newcastle Utd) replacing Anthony Gordon.
68' A substitution has been made. Alexander Isak goes off and Callum Wilson (Newcastle Utd) comes on.
67' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.

64' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot just over the bar. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better! The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.

64' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the right side of the goal, but Nick Pope made a crucial save!
64' Here comes a substitution. Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for John McGinn.
61' Total attempts – 11:9.

58' 3 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 3:1.
55' The ball is out of play. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner.
53' Anthony Gordon (Newcastle Utd) has tested the patience of referee Andy Madley and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

52' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
52' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. Newcastle win a corner.
51' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
49' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
48' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
46' The substitution is prepared. Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Leon Bailey.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+12' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+9' What was Sven Botman (Newcastle Utd) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
45+9' The foul by Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Andy Madley.
45+6' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
45+4' Aston Villa are seeing far more of the ball now.
45+3' Kieran Trippier (Newcastle Utd) sends a cross into the box, but Emiliano Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+2' Newcastle seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
45' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

42' Good chance! Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Newcastle will have a goal kick.
39' 4:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
38' Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
35' Aston Villa earn a corner.
32' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
31' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pau Torres is coming onto the pitch as Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
25' It doesn’t look good for Tyrone Mings (Aston Villa); looks like he’ll be heading for an early bath!

24' Close! Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Newcastle.
23' Looks like Bruno Guimaraes (Newcastle Utd) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
20' Neat passing move from Aston Villa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
18' Andy Madley sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
17' Wait! Referee Andy Madley has indicated he is going to review the Newcastle goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
16' 2 - 1 Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) reacts quickly in the penalty area and scores with aplomb, giving the goalkeeper no chance!
15' The ball possession is 61:39.
11' 1 - 1 Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) scores! Ollie Watkins heads the ball into his path before he drives in an effort that is too powerful for the goalkeeper to keep out. 1:1.
8' Newcastle take a short corner kick.

8' A sweet pass finds Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Emiliano Martinez is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The ball goes behind for a corner. Newcastle will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

6' 1 - 0 Sandro Tonali (Newcastle Utd) meets a perfect cross from Anthony Gordon deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the left post. It's 1:0.
6' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
4' Alexander Isak (Newcastle Utd) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
3' The Newcastle players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Andy Madley is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
